comment: Shexli findings accepted, each with the reason. tools/package-check.sh fails on any error, and on any finding not listed here (same rule, files a subset of the listed ones).

accepted.reason: Clipboard access is declared in the metadata description, as the GNOME Shell extension guidelines require: results are copied when picked, and /clip keeps an in-memory history of text copies (off in Settings; never for copies carrying x-kde-passwordManagerHint).

Per-row actors (icon bin, labels, pin) are children of the panel's actor tree. They are destroyed with it on every re-render (destroy_all_children) and in disable() (launcher.destroy -> panel.destroy -> backdrop.destroy).
Same per-row objects as EGO-L-002: the Item that holds the references is dropped with the panel, which disable() destroys.
The per-row hover and button-release handlers are connected on the row's own actor and go away when that actor is destroyed with the panel (re-render and disable()).
